newsitem.title: PERU: Fourth Peru bus crash in week kills at least 20.
newsitem.headline: Fourth Peru bus crash in week kills at least 20.

text.p: At least 20 passengers died and up to 50 were injured on Friday in Peru's fourth major bus crash in a week, local police said.

A crowded bus plunged down the side of a valley as it snaked through the Andean highlands in heavy rain and dense fog shortly after midnight in La Convencion in the department of Cusco, about 500 miles (800 km) south of Lima, police said.
Rescue workers battled to recover bodies from the wreckage of the crash, on the side of a mountain 9,000 feet (3,000 meters) above sea level, they said.
The cause of the accident was unkown.
Four bus accidents in Peru since last Friday have killed over 80 people and injured a further 180.

The frequency of road accidents in Peru, where most people travel along poorly maintained highways on buses that are often overloaded, has led pressure groups to call for an overhaul of the country's transport regulations.
